note: Internal. What each wrapped tool can do, taken from its pinned release's documentation, set against the tool-use registry (migkit/tooluse.py). A capability names the registry options it covers as 'command option' (command empty for a program without subcommands); its state is computed, never written. 'candidate' marks a capability that would deepen the rung named in 'rung' and is worth a backlog row while it is unused.

system_programs./usr/libexec/java_home: locates the Java runtime other tools run on
system_programs.uv: Python environment manager that installs other tools
system_programs.uvx: Python environment manager that installs other tools
system_programs.docker: container runtime the sandbox and images run on
